# Exercise 4 answer script
# Expected output variables:
# total_units_per_product, grand_total, month_totals, best_month

# ===== DO NOT EDIT: LOCAL TEST FALLBACK START =====
if (!exists("sales")) {
  sales <- matrix(c(120, 95, 140, 85, 110, 130), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  rownames(sales) <- c("A", "B")
  colnames(sales) <- paste0("M", 1:3)
}
# ===== DO NOT EDIT: LOCAL TEST FALLBACK END =====

# ===== YOUR SOLUTION START =====
total_units_per_product <- rowSums(sales)
grand_total <- sum(sales)
month_totals <- colSums(sales)
best_month <- unname(which.max(month_totals))
# ===== YOUR SOLUTION END =====
